text: 2. Have you been to that restaurant in the main street? Yeah, a couple of times. Is it any good? Yeah. The menu's a bit limited. I mean, there aren't really any options if you're vegetarian, but it's good homestyle cooking. Right. It's just that I went past and it was almost deserted. I know. I'm surprised they stay in business, to be honest. They should advertise in the paper or something, because the food's nice and they're very friendly. Well, they might attract a few more people if they redecorated, even if they just repainted it. That's true. I suppose the restaurant doesn't look very inviting.
